items.headline: CBI sales beat big: -10 vs -47 expected — smallest UK retail fall in 18 months
bullets: UK retail sales volumes fell at their slowest pace since April 2025: the CBI balance improved to -10 in October from -55 in September, well above the -47 consensus.
Orders placed with suppliers also eased to -36 from September's record-low -62; retailers expect sales to fall at the same modest -10 pace in November.
Sterling did not rally on the beat — it eased in London trade on pre-Budget positioning ($1.3348), so Wednesday's Budget still dominates GBP.

items.headline: Trump signs the Canada tariff proclamation — plywood/paper/machinery out, valves/carpets/waste in; effective Oct 30

USD/CAD ~1.40, flat on the day; the loonie's five-week high is about oil plus ~80% BoC-hike pricing for Oct 28, not this move — no verified tariff-driven repricing.
